review.why: Evaluates and plans free calculators, graders and generators as a marketing channel, with an eight-factor scorecard and an MVP scope.
review.summary: Gives principles for a good marketing tool (solves a real problem, adjacent to the product, simple, worth the cost), a table of tool types, an ideation and validation method, gating options and lead-capture practice, SEO and link angles, a build-versus-no-code choice, and a 1 to 5 scorecard over eight factors. It ends with common pitfalls.
strengths: Scorecard with clear bands turns a vague idea into a go or no-go
Names pitfalls: over-building, no path to the product, upkeep and security debt
MVP scope says what to skip first
cautions: Does not build the tool, only plans and scores it
Benchmarks and sourced case studies are in files not read here
Scorecard weights are equal, which may not fit every business
